mainEntity.name: Should I choose tile, vinyl, or wood for my kitchen floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comparing materials is usually more useful than comparing installers alone. Porcelain tile tends to be very moisture-resistant, vinyl is often more budget-friendly and comfortable underfoot, and wood can look warm but may be less forgiving in a kitchen if spills and heavy use are frequent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile is usually the most moisture-resistant, vinyl is often the most budget-friendly, and wood offers a warmer look but can be less forgiving in a kitchen. The best choice depends on moisture, traffic, and budget.
